five_day_thesis: Spot is net −$62.7 over five sessions (4,383.7 → 4,321.0) but the decline stopped at $4,297.9 on 09-25 and has since recovered, so the tape has gone from trending-down to basing. The more telling shift is under the surface: put OI grew +6.7% (85,447 → 91,182) against just +2.0% for calls, lifting P/C OI 0.38 → 0.40 — downside is being bought, not sold. ATM IV has compressed five readings in a row, 21.56% → 20.79% (−0.77pp), while windowed net GEX decayed 625.0 → 370.6 into the 09-25 low and has since rebuilt to 410.1 — the stabilizing cushion thinned during the selloff and is now reforming. Both walls are immovable: put wall $3,500 and call wall $6,000 unpinned for all five days, and max pain has sat frozen at $5,500 every session. The real 5-day positioning event is a +1,983-contract call build at $5,000 (7,661 → 9,644), the largest single-strike change in the chain, layered above +318 at $4,700 and +257 at $4,800.
